title: Tap to avoid a train fine
scenario: A person wearing a rail-company vest says your mobile ticket did not validate. They point to a QR code on a handheld sign and say paying a €15 correction fee now avoids a much larger inspection fine.

answers.A: Ask to verify the issue at the staffed ticket desk or with the official rail app before scanning or paying.
answers.B: Ask the person to show official ID and explain exactly why your ticket is invalid.
answers.C: Scan the QR code and check whether the payment page shows the rail-company logo before paying.

explanation: Uniforms and urgency can be copied. A genuine ticket problem should be verifiable in the operator’s own system.
proTip: A uniform is a cue; the operator’s system is evidence.
